selection: Eight previously unused Codeforces problems chosen by algorithm family and complete input/output statements, before any agent outcomes. Ratings 1600-2100. No filtering by verifier success or model outcomes.
checker_review: All eight statements require one uniquely determined integer. Whitespace-token comparison is sufficient.
generated_tests: Excluded from this plumbing pilot before agent runs because generated input-domain validity has not been reviewed. Source data remains unchanged.

agent_limits.meaning: No imposed agent budget for this plumbing pilot

tasks.family: Binary search with a difference-array feasibility check
Binary search with integer division and inclusion-exclusion
Subarray sums, product overflow, and rectangle boundaries
Counting pairs with duplicates and inclusive division boundaries
Prefix sums and strict triangle-inequality boundaries
Interval dynamic programming and empty-interval base cases
Dynamic programming with unreachable states and rain boundaries
Prefix remainders and dynamic programming over nonempty partitions

purpose: Calibration only, excluded from future confirmatory evaluation

screening_exclusions.cf-922-E: An input constraint is missing and represented as <image>.

criteria.workflow_ready: Agents consume tool observations before submission, with no infrastructure errors.
criteria.verifier_engagement: Record calls and consumed diagnostics separately from hidden-test outcomes. Unsupported or skipped checks do not establish verification.
criteria.difficulty_headroom: Baseline hidden-test success below 100 percent indicates headroom in this sample.
criteria.descriptive_outcome: Report both success rates and paired wins/losses/ties. No significance or efficacy claim from eight tasks.
criteria.inconclusive_for_feedback_effect: No verifier calls, no supported diagnostics, baseline ceiling, or infrastructure errors prevent a useful feedback-effect interpretation.
